system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

The Yoton clan has had a secret technique for generations. For most Yoton, this becomes their ultimate expression of combat genius. But for you, it is simply a stepping stone for what comes next. But this stepping stone isn’t small nor minor. This is the ultimate for the clan. You learn to excrete magma chakra from your very pores, coating yourself in lava, until it forms armor. Both protecting and enhancing you.

As a Bonus action, you can enter your Lava Chakra Mode for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

Alternatively, by standing within two overlapping Molten Terrain’s while in combat, you can spend a Bonus action, dispelling both and entering Lava Chakra Mode. You can only enter Lava Chakra mode in this way, once per long rest.
